∀ (pre : Minidregg.Kernel.SystemCell.System) (chain : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest), Minidregg.Kernel.TailBound.judge pre (pre.certifiedHeight + pre.tailBound + 1) chain [] = Except.error (Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.RejectReason.tailBound (pre.certifiedHeight + pre.tailBound + 1) pre.certifiedHeight pre.tailBound)

∀ {rootBytes : List UInt8 → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest} {systemId : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.CellId} {head : ℕ} {chain : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest} {snapshot : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataSnapshot rootBytes} {intent : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataIntent rootBytes}, Minidregg.Kernel.TailBound.gate systemId head chain snapshot intent = Except.ok () → ∀ write ∈ intent.writes, write.cellId = systemId → ∀ (post : Minidregg.Kernel.SystemCell.System), Minidregg.Kernel.TailBound.valueOf write.canonicalPostBytes = Option.some post → ∃ pre, Minidregg.Kernel.TailBound.valueOf (snapshot.canonicalBytes systemId) = Option.some pre ∧ pre.certifiedHeight < post.certifiedHeight ∧ post.tailBound = pre.tailBound

∀ {rootBytes : List UInt8 → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest} {systemId : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.CellId} {head : ℕ} {chain : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest} {snapshot : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataSnapshot rootBytes} {intent : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataIntent rootBytes}, Minidregg.Kernel.TailBound.gate systemId head chain snapshot intent = Except.ok () → ∀ write ∈ intent.writes, write.cellId = systemId → ∃ pre, Minidregg.Kernel.TailBound.valueOf (snapshot.canonicalBytes systemId) = Option.some pre ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.TailBound.systemPosts systemId intent = [Option.some (Minidregg.Kernel.SystemCell.certifyNext pre (head - 1) chain)] ∧ pre.certifiedHeight < head - 1

Minidregg.Kernel.TailBound.judge { certifiedHeight := 64, certifiedDigest := { value := 7 }, tailBound := 8 } 73 { value := 9 } [Option.some { certifiedHeight := 72, certifiedDigest := { value := 9 }, tailBound := 8 }] = Except.ok ()

Minidregg.Kernel.TailBound.judge { certifiedHeight := 64, certifiedDigest := { value := 7 }, tailBound := 8 } 73 { value := 9 } [Option.some { certifiedHeight := 72, certifiedDigest := { value := 9 }, tailBound := 1000 }] = Except.error Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.RejectReason.systemWriteRefused

Minidregg.Kernel.TailBound.judge { certifiedHeight := 64, certifiedDigest := { value := 7 }, tailBound := 8 } 73 { value := 9 } [Option.some { certifiedHeight := 72, certifiedDigest := { value := 8 }, tailBound := 8 }] = Except.error Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.RejectReason.systemWriteRefused

∀ (pre : Minidregg.Kernel.SystemCell.System) (n : ℕ) (chain : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest), pre.certifiedHeight < n → Minidregg.Kernel.TailBound.judge pre (n + 1) chain [Option.some (Minidregg.Kernel.SystemCell.certifyNext pre n chain)] = Except.ok () ∧ ∀ head ≤ n + pre.tailBound, ∀ (later : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest), Minidregg.Kernel.TailBound.judge (Minidregg.Kernel.SystemCell.certifyNext pre n chain) head later [] = Except.ok ()

∀ {pre : Minidregg.Kernel.SystemCell.System} {head : ℕ} {chain : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest}, Minidregg.Kernel.TailBound.judge pre head chain [] = Except.ok () → head ≤ pre.certifiedHeight + pre.tailBound

∀ {pre : Minidregg.Kernel.SystemCell.System} {head : ℕ} {chain : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest} {posts : List (Option Minidregg.Kernel.SystemCell.System)}, posts ≠ [] → Minidregg.Kernel.TailBound.judge pre head chain posts = Except.ok () → posts = [Option.some (Minidregg.Kernel.SystemCell.certifyNext pre (head - 1) chain)] ∧ pre.certifiedHeight < head - 1

∀ {rootBytes : List UInt8 → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest} (systemId : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.CellId) (intent : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataIntent rootBytes), Minidregg.Kernel.TailBound.systemPosts systemId intent = [] ↔ ∀ write ∈ intent.writes, write.cellId ≠ systemId

Minidregg.Kernel.TailBound.judge { certifiedHeight := 64, certifiedDigest := { value := 7 }, tailBound := 8 } 73 { value := 9 } [] = Except.error (Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.RejectReason.tailBound 73 64 8)

∀ {rootBytes : List UInt8 → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest} {systemId : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.CellId} {head : ℕ} {chain : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest} {snapshot : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataSnapshot rootBytes} {intent : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataIntent rootBytes}, Minidregg.Kernel.TailBound.gate systemId head chain snapshot intent = Except.ok () → (∀ write ∈ intent.writes, write.cellId ≠ systemId) → ∃ pre, Minidregg.Kernel.TailBound.valueOf (snapshot.canonicalBytes systemId) = Option.some pre ∧ head - pre.certifiedHeight ≤ pre.tailBound

∀ {rootBytes : List UInt8 → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest} {systemId : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.CellId} {head : ℕ} {chain : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest} {snapshot : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataSnapshot rootBytes} {intent : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataIntent rootBytes}, Minidregg.Kernel.TailBound.valueOf (snapshot.canonicalBytes systemId) = Option.none → Minidregg.Kernel.TailBound.gate systemId head chain snapshot intent = Except.error Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.RejectReason.systemUnavailable
